description: Demo PR #62 changes the Order Sync retry policy and adds an ERP timeout and a dead-letter queue. The wiki page /Order Sync/Overview documents none of it.
prompt: Pull request 62 in wdhm/foundry-agentic-pattern changes the Order Sync integration. Read the changed files at the requested commit on GitHub, compare what they implement with the Azure DevOps wiki page /Order Sync/Overview and the documentation standard, and list what the documentation is missing. Cite evidence (source, path, version).

planted_gaps.title: Retry policy changed: 3 fixed attempts (5 s) became 5 attempts with exponential backoff from 2 s
New configuration key erp.timeoutSeconds (30) is undocumented
New dead-letter queue orders-confirmed-failed is undocumented
